## Core Architectural Principles
- **Sub-0.8s Page Speed Target:** Fully optimized for Google Core Web Vitals (LCP < 1.2s, FID/INP < 100ms, CLS < 0.05).
- **Zero SEO Ranking Loss:** 100% 1-to-1 HTTP 301 redirection mapping on redesigns preserving indexed organic equity.
- **Clean Code Over Bloated Page Builders:** Bespoke PHP, React 19, Next.js 15, and modular WordPress block themes without 40+ conflicting plugins.
- **Direct Technical Ownership:** 100% direct founder consultation, planning, and code review.
- **100% IP & Repository Handover:** Full Git source code, administrative rights, and credentials transferred upon launch.
